subject.title: fix(agents): reject partial fallback skip TTL env values

question: Should the shipped environment variable now reject suffix-bearing numeric prefixes and disable the cache, accepting the behavior change for operators who relied on undocumented `parseInt` semantics?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and aligns with the documented grammar, but repository policy treats stricter environment parsing and changed fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive decisions that require owner intent.

options.title: Accept strict integer grammar
options.body: Merge the current approach so malformed tokens disable the cache and only complete non-negative decimal integers remain supported.

options.title: Preserve an explicit compatibility form
options.body: Pause the PR and define, document, and test a supported duration-suffix grammar rather than retaining accidental prefix parsing.
